response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished senior full-stack/web software engineer with strong experience in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, but the role requires deep expertise in SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, GPU/AI accelerator performance analysis, and hardware-software co-design — none of which appear in the resume. Aside from some low-latency systems work at Dunnhumby and a bachelor's thesis involving audio hardware, there is no evidence of hardware modeling, deep-learning workload optimization, or architecture-level performance work, making this a fundamental domain mismatch for a Principal Performance Architect position.
strengths: 15+ years of professional software engineering experience, exceeding tenure requirements
Some low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (async I/O, fibers, caching in DLang)
Demonstrated technical breadth, open-source contributions, and knowledge-sharing (talks, workshops)
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture, or hardware-software co-design experience
No background in deep-learning training/inference optimization or AI accelerator workloads
Career trajectory is web/product engineering, not performance architecture at the hardware level
